title: Where to donate books in Toronto
meta_description: Where to donate books in Toronto: what the library, BOOKEnds, the Children's Book Bank, Trinity and Victoria each accept, and where to take them.
hub_blurb: The places in Toronto that accept donated books each set different rules, and each one publishes them. Toronto Public Library branches want books under five years old in English or French. BOOKEnds takes the vintage and non-English titles the branches refuse. The Children's Book Bank opens its warehouse on a handful of Saturdays a year. Trinity and Victoria colleges will take twenty boxes at a time for their annual sales. Diabetes Canada collects books from your doorstep but will not take them in a clothing bin, and Book Clubs for Inmates will not take used books at all. Addresses, dates, box limits, the refusal lists, and what to do with the books nobody wants.
